content: Boom! League sources tell me Week 6 is loaded, and the Pacific Pigskins (8-1) head into a showdown with The Mariachi Ninjas (3-6) projected at 133.0 to 98.2. Money is nice, but championships are better, and Pacific is chasing one. Track every point as it lands on the live scoreboard.

I'm told Vitside Mafia (8-1) is the biggest bully on the board, projected 148.1 against Cowboy Up's 112.9. Josh Allen (28.6) and Matthew Stafford (24.6) are a nightmare combination, and I'm picking Vitside to win going away. Cowboy Up needs Joe Burrow (24.2) to carry the load, and that's a lot to ask. Check your lineup before kickoff, because Cowboy Up can't afford a bye-week mistake.

Here's my upset special: Running down the Dream (7-2) projected 126.7 against Dead Cap Walking (1-8) at 88.7. Derrick Henry (19.1) and Jaxon Smith-Njigba (18.9) make Dream the favorite, but Dead Cap is waving the white flag on the year. Dead Cap needs a miracle, and I'm not sure they can find one. If you want to see how the season is shaping up, the standings tell the whole story.

Dark Magicians of Chaos (4-5) against Gridiron Geeks (7-2) is the one I'm circling. Dak Prescott (26.2) and Jayden Daniels (26.0) give Dark Magicians serious firepower, and I'm calling the upset here. Gridiron Geeks has Jordan Love and Daniel Jones, but this one is close, and I'd bet the rivalry heat on it. Browse the rivalry pages to see how these two have traded punches.

Now for the broadcast guide. The big games to watch are Baltimore with Lamar Jackson (Pacific Pigskins) and Derrick Henry (Running down the Dream), plus Buffalo with Josh Allen (Vitside Mafia) and James Cook (The Mariachi Ninjas). Cincinnati is a must-watch with Ja'Marr Chase, Joe Burrow, and Chase Brown all on the slate. Detroit has Jared Goff, Jahmyr Gibbs, Sam LaPorta, and Amon-Ra St. Brown, so Pacific and Bring The Pain both have stakes there. Atlanta has Bijan Robinson, Michael Penix Jr., and Kyle Pitts, so Computer Jocks and Music City Mafia are glued to that one.

Heads up on the early window: Arizona has Trey McBride, Michael Wilson, and Jacoby Brissett, so Da Dangsters, Cowboy Up, and Music City Mafia are all tuned in. Dallas has CeeDee Lamb, Javonte Williams, and Dak Prescott, a big swing for Da Dangsters and Dark Magicians. Carolina has Chuba Hubbard, Tetairoa McMillan, and Bryce Young, and Fire Ready Aim is counting on Young. Track all of it on the Sunday Ticket board so nothing slips past you.
